applicability: When the task entry's changed-intent summary is re-read in the dashboard.
conditions: The entry is mounted for its repository, master and leaf; re-show, return and explicit refresh keep their existing local-context revalidation path.

A mounted active-worktree review with history other than recorded registers its exact repo/master/leaf scope on the existing state stream. Its first baseline, reconnect baseline or changed revision invokes the registered memoryChanged and shared-entry revalidation callbacks.
The summary hook keys its read/display by the addressed target and facts, including the caller's entry generation, and admits only its current mounted sequence.
exclusions: A standalone entry installs no review-memory watch; closed/recorded review scopes do not register through this hook.
A revision notification invalidates supplied inputs; it is not a knowledge body, a measured zero or semantic acceptance.
No global analytics-triggered reread or fresh latency/installed-delivery certification is inferred.
statement: The entry summary is revalidated under the addressed leaf's lifecycle/worktree facts and shared entry generation. Navigation, explicit reviewer refresh and the matching mounted live review's memory invalidation advance that generation; an unrelated workspace analytics publication does not. A late answer for a previous leaf is dropped.
